spans.text: **A well-structured paper with fabricated content will still fail verification. Build for accuracy.**
spans.note: The prompt strongly emphasizes academic integrity, citation verification, and truthfulness. It explicitly instructs the agent to never fabricate examples or statistics, to mark uncertain information with [VERIFY] or [TODO] placeholders, and to ensure all claims are traceable to sources.

spans.text: Specify target journal/conference and citation style
spans.note: The prompt preserves user agency by requiring user input at multiple stages: specifying target journal, citation style, and attaching their own outline. It provides options (IMRaD, IEEE, APA, Chicago) rather than forcing a single choice, and structures the workflow as a collaborative process.

spans.text: **CRITICAL:** When structuring the paper, ensure all claims are traceable to sources.
spans.note: The prompt actively works to prevent academic harm through its strong emphasis on academic integrity, proper citation practices, and verification requirements. It warns against practices that could lead to academic misconduct such as fabricated citations or using unreliable reference links.
